Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: multiple teams asked how credits, quotas, and emergency burst handling work together during launches. Can someone summarize the practical rules and who to contact?

Samir (VP Product): High level: credits = monetary only, do not change rate limits. Quotas = access control (hard/soft limits). Burst buffer = temporary token-bucket allowance for short spikes. For anything beyond the burst buffer, open a launch support request.

Jamie (Finance): To reiterate: promotional credits reduce invoices, they don't alter technical quotas. If Sales wants to include higher throughput in a deal, that must be a contract amendment (reserved capacity or quota uplift).

Nina (Solutions): Request pattern we recommend for customers: 1) submit Launch Support form with expected window and peak RPS, 2) include a traffic sample, 3) pick fallbacks (model downgrade, caching). We provide a checklist in the console.

Riley (Support): Operational checklist in support: account ID, start/end, peak RPS, endpoint, auth token sample. We triage within 2 hours for standard requests; use the hotline for mission-critical launches.

DevOpsBot: Current per-account default write QPS: 100 req/s. Burst: +25% token-bucket for 45s. Temp increase API: POST /admin/temp_quota_request returns request_id; requires approver approval.

Ethan (Eng): Important note: automatic retries should respect 429 + Retry-After. Our SDKs implement exponential backoff with jitter by default. Avoid aggressive client-side retries during a launch spike.

Samir (VP Product): Action items: 1) publish a one-page Launch Playbook in Docs and Console (Maya/Nina to own), 2) add a console button to request temporary quota increases, 3) update Sales/CS playbook about credits vs quota.

Ava (CEO): Thanks. Prioritize the console checklist and a short FAQ card explaining "credits vs quota vs reserved capacity". Can we get a draft by next Tue?

Jamie (Finance): I'll draft the FAQ blurb about credits and invoicing and share with Sales.

Riley (Support): I'll prepare canned responses and the triage checklist.

Samir (VP Product): Filed DOCS-2306 and ENG-4201 for the console changes. Will update this thread when PRs are ready.

Ava (CEO): Great work, closing thread.
